reviews.review: One of my most favorite games since its launch

I use to play on ps5 and got a pc it is all around a good game and played 60 hours on pc and maybe around 1000 on ps5 totally recommend the game, you have to grind and farm a lot but is so worth it the sheer varity of warframes and weapons is amazing and the warframes are so fun, my favorite is Gauss. This game is free.

This game is good if you have:
- No money
- Lot's of spare time
- No life 
- No girlfriend/wife
- Haven't touch a grass in your life
- Haven't touch a girls in your entire life 

Trust me you never cheated on your partner once u hooked to this game cuz u gonna spend ur whole times killing alien bastards, overrall this game is the best MMO game ive played so far.

Played the game for 1,055 hours was a really fun game had great story line and it was relatively easy to get what you were grinding for whether it be through trading or relics(relic route takes a lot longer can very easily take weeks to get items you are looking for if you are unlucky). The point is that there were so many ways to get what you were looking for. The only down side of the game is how long it takes you to build the gear if you don't have the premium currency it takes anywhere from 8 hours to 3 days to build, although that is a major difference the very point of which I discovered through playing is that it's a very grinding game. If you do not like grinding games this isn't for you it can take hours to days farming relics for the items you are looking for to "complete" your arsenal or you can take the long route which is what I did spent 1,000 hours on the game to get all the prime frames.

That being said and with the 1k hours spent on the game if you absolutely love grinding games and games that can help waste times warframe is a great choice, Community wise players are great always willing to help if you ask and are very understanding of new players. 

Pros-
-Fan base is great and very understanding of new people and are normally willing to help them level up.
- game is a very great way to waste time I remember countless times getting on in the morning whether it be before work or school I would put a few hours into the game.
cons- 
-Very grindy game so once again if grinding games aren't for you don't play the game
-gear takes hours to days to complete without the help of premium currency


This game as exceed my expectations for free to play games as most free to play games aren't as immersive or as detailed as this one. Attention to detail was done great on both items and worlds compared to a lot of other free to play games that you probably play for a few days then quit because of it not being fun or just graphics wise not being good. Since a lot of people care about graphics some of the great games out there are pushed aside due to them not having the greatest of detail put into them. However with warframe it's different all the items are detailed really well and every item comes with the choice of customizing it to the color scheme that you want. 

My over all review of the game is that it was one of the best free to play games to play, I stopped playing a while ago due to how many hours I put into it and the fact that I was starting to branch out into other games. Will I play it again most likely due to the fact that they keep adding new items into the game, however for now I'm taking a break for the game as my main goal near the end of my playing time was to get all the current prime frames which is what I did, I just never had a lot of time to play the the game anymore after I had gotten all the frames so I slowly pushed this game to the side and focused on other games. It's a great game and it's a nice way to relax and grind hours away getting items or leveling up your gear to modify them even more to get enough mod slots to get your gear to your desired needs whether it be for PVP or PVE.
Seems ok. Need to play a bit more to make sure
